displayIdentity.body: Paul meets James and enters a purification rite. When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly. Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
displayIdentity.title: Paul meets James and enters a purification rite
